Visibility and Tracking

Метка времени

A precise digital record of the exact date and time an event occurs within the logistics chain, as captured in transport documents, tracking platforms, and data loggers for audit, compliance, and claims management.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Метка времени?

In this glossary, Метка времени refers to: A precise digital record of the exact date and time an event occurs within the logistics chain, as captured in transport documents, tracking platforms, and data loggers for audit, compliance, and claims management.

How is Метка времени used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Метка времени фиксируется при прибытии отправления на склад и используется для подтверждения своевременности исполнения в аудите уровня сервиса."

Why does Метка времени matter in logistics?

Метка времени matters because it supports clear communication in Visibility and Tracking contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Метка времени?

Метка времени is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Метка времени belong to?

In this glossary, Метка времени is grouped under Visibility and Tracking. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A precise digital record of the exact date and time an event occurs within the logistics chain, as captured in transport documents, tracking platforms, and data loggers for audit, compliance, and claims management.

Operational example

A time stamp is recorded when the shipment arrives at the warehouse and is used to verify on-time performance in service-level audits.

Localized term

Метка времени

Localized example

Метка времени фиксируется при прибытии отправления на склад и используется для подтверждения своевременности исполнения в аудите уровня сервиса.
